Codebase: /opt/nxeon (Next.js 15 App Router, React 19, Tailwind v4 with tokens in app/globals.css @theme + @layer components, Prisma/Postgres). Customer portal = app/dashboard/** + components/customer/** + components/portal/** (+ components/ui/primitives.tsx which is known to exist).

HARD RULES: STRICTLY READ-ONLY. Do NOT edit/create/delete ANY file under /opt/nxeon, /opt/nxeon-staging or /opt/nxeon-sandbox. No build, npm, prisma, db, git-write, or service commands. Do not read .env* files. Your ONLY write is your report file: /tmp/claude-0/-root/1716c7ee-ae35-4cf5-b557-9059709e07c4/scratchpad/audit-02-design-system.md (Write tool). Exhaustive, factual, cite repo-relative file paths, use tables, mark uncertain items UNVERIFIED. Inventory + diagnosis only, no design proposals.

EFFICIENCY: this audit is mostly grep/count work — lean on `grep -rno ... | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn` pipelines and batch independent shell calls in one message. Read whole files only for globals.css and components/ui/primitives.tsx.

YOUR AUDIT: DESIGN SYSTEM / CSS / COMPONENT DUPLICATION / ICON CENSUS / TYPOGRAPHY / MOTION.
Produce:
1. TOKENS: dump and explain everything in app/globals.css (@theme colours, fonts, radii, shadows, animations, @layer components classes like .card/.btn-*/.input/.label/.nav-item-active/.table-shell/.eyebrow/.grad-text, .tone-light, any utilities). Also tailwind config if any, postcss config, font loading (app/layout.tsx, next/font), any CSS modules or styled files. List every named colour scale and its hex values.
2. HARDCODED STYLE CENSUS across components/customer/**, components/portal/**, app/dashboard/**: count of hex colours / rgb() / arbitrary Tailwind values like bg-[#...] / text-[..px] / inline style= attributes; list the top 30 most-used arbitrary values; count usages of each brand colour utility (brand-*, navy-*, accent-*, violet/purple/indigo/cyan/blue) to show where purple dominance comes from; count of gradient utilities (bg-gradient, from-, via-), blur/glow/backdrop-blur, shadow-*, rounded-* distribution (how many rounded-xl/2xl/3xl), border usage.
3. COMPONENT DUPLICATION: find visually-similar-but-separately-implemented patterns. For each of: buttons, badges/status pills, cards, tabs, segmented controls, modals/dialogs, drawers/sheets, confirmation dialogs, toasts/notifications, tables, key/value lists, empty states, skeletons/spinners, progress bars/steps, wizards/steppers, copy-to-clipboard, code/mono value display, metric/stat tiles, charts/graphs, resource meters, file browsers, terminals/consoles, log viewers, DNS editors, form fields (input/select/textarea/toggle/checkbox/radio/slider), page headers, section headers, region selectors, plan cards, pricing cards, app/one-click cards, game cards — list every implementation (file path + how it's styled), count them, and note which could collapse into one primitive. Assess how consistently components/ui/primitives.tsx is actually used vs bypassed.
4. ICON CENSUS: which icon libraries are imported (lucide-react, @heroicons, react-icons, radix-icons, tabler, phosphor, custom) with import counts per library across the portal; count of inline <svg> elements in customer/portal components; list custom icon components; note stroke-width / size inconsistencies (grep for strokeWidth, size=, className w-3/w-4/w-5/w-6 on icons); emoji used as icons.
5. TYPOGRAPHY: font families used, all text-size utilities distribution (text-xs..text-6xl counts), font-weight distribution, tracking/leading usage, heading patterns (how h1/h2 look per page — inconsistencies), monospace usage for technical values (font-mono count and where), number formatting.
6. MOTION: animation libs (framer-motion? motion? gsap? css only?), keyframes defined, animate-* utilities usage, transition patterns, reduced-motion handling (prefers-reduced-motion grep).
7. LAYOUT GEOMETRY: page max-widths used per route (max-w-* census), padding patterns, grid patterns, how page headers are built per page; z-index census; breakpoint usage (sm/md/lg/xl/2xl counts).
8. Chart/visualisation libs (recharts? chart.js? custom svg?) and where used.
9. Diagnosis: top inconsistencies with concrete evidence and rough counts (e.g. '7 different badge implementations', '4 tab styles').
Finish by writing the report, then reply with a ~12-line summary with key counts.

# Audit 02 — Design System / CSS / Component Duplication / Icons / Typography / Motion

**Scope:** `app/dashboard/**`, `components/customer/**`, `components/portal/**` (+ `components/ui/*`).
**Method:** read-only. Whole-file reads limited to `app/globals.css`, `components/ui/primitives.tsx`,
`components/customer/cpanel/shared.tsx`, `components/customer/hosting/shared.tsx`. Everything else is
`grep -rno … | sort | uniq -c` census. Counts are **occurrence counts of the literal token in `.tsx` source**,
not runtime render counts. Regex census can slightly over/under-count where a class string spans lines —
those places are marked.

**Portal size:** 245 `.tsx` files, ~59,300 LOC. 169 of 245 are `"use client"`.
64 route files under `app/dashboard/**`, 181 components under `components/customer/**`, 3 under `components/portal/**`.

---

## 1. TOKENS — the design system as actually defined

### 1.1 Build config

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Tailwind | v4.1.11, **CSS-first** (`@import "tailwindcss"` + `@theme` in `app/globals.css`) |
| `tailwind.config.{js,ts,mjs}` | **Does not exist** — verified, no config file outside `node_modules` |
| PostCSS | `postcss.config.mjs` → single plugin `@tailwindcss/postcss` |
| Global stylesheet | `app/globals.css` — **596 lines, the only global CSS in the portal** |
| CSS Modules in portal | **0** (5 `.module.css` files exist but all under `components/marketing/*template/`) |
| CSS-in-JS libs | none |
| Design-token source of truth | `app/globals.css` `@theme` block only |

### 1.2 Fonts

Loaded in `app/layout.tsx` via `next/font/google`, self-hosted:

```
const geistSans = Geist({ subsets:["latin"], variable:"--font-geist-sans", display:"swap" });
const geistMono = Geist_Mono({ subsets:["latin"], variable:"--font-geist-mono", display:"swap" });
```

Mapped in `@theme`:

| Token | Value |
|---|---|
| `--font-sans` | `var(--font-geist-sans), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif` |
| `--font-mono` | `var(--font-geist-mono), ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", "Menlo", monospace` |

`body { @apply … font-sans }` — one typeface site-wide, no per-route font overrides found in the portal.

### 1.3 Colour scales (every named colour + hex)

**`brand` (violet) — 10 stops**

| Token | Hex |
|---|---|
| `--color-brand-50` | `#f2f0ff` |
| `--color-brand-100` | `#e4e0ff` |
| `--color-brand-200` | `#c9c2ff` |
| `--color-brand-300` | `#a89aff` |
| `--color-brand-400` | `#8a70fb` |
| `--color-brand-500` | `#6f47f5` |
| `--color-brand-600` | `#5f2ee8` |
| `--color-brand-700` | `#5124c4` |
| `--color-brand-800` | `#421fa0` |
| `--color-brand-900` | `#371d7f` |

**`navy` (surfaces) — 6 stops** (note: **starts at 600, no 50–500**, and includes a non-standard `850`)

| Token | Hex |
|---|---|
| `--color-navy-950` | `#060a14` |
| `--color-navy-900` | `#0a101f` |
| `--color-navy-850` | `#0d1526` |
| `--color-navy-800` | `#111a30` |
| `--color-navy-700` | `#1a2540` |
| `--color-navy-600` | `#253354` |

**`accent` — 2 single-value tokens (no scale)**

| Token | Hex |
|---|---|
| `--color-accent-blue` | `#3b82f6` (= Tailwind blue-500) |
| `--color-accent-cyan` | `#22d3ee` (= Tailwind cyan-400) |

Everything else — `slate`, `emerald`, `red`, `amber`, `sky`, `teal`, `orange`, `rose`, `lime`, `violet`,
`indigo`, `fuchsia` — is **stock Tailwind**, not brand-defined. There is **no semantic token layer**
(no `--color-success`, `--color-danger`, `--color-surface`, `--color-border`, `--color-text-muted`).
Status colour is expressed everywhere as raw palette names.

Two runtime CSS custom properties exist for foreground, declared *inside* `@layer components` on `:root`:

| Var | Default | Under `.tone-light` |
|---|---|---|
| `--fg` | `#ffffff` | `#0f172a` |
| `--fg-muted` | `#94a3b8` | `#475569` |

### 1.4 Radii / shadows

**No radius or shadow tokens are defined in `@theme`.** Tailwind's stock radius scale is used, and every
custom shadow is a hardcoded `box-shadow` literal inside a `@layer components` rule:

| Class | Shadow |
|---|---|
| `.card` | `0 1px 0 0 rgb(255 255 255/.03) inset, 0 8px 32px -12px rgb(0 0 0/.5)` |
| `.wizard-shell` | card's two layers + `0 0 60px -22px rgb(111 71 245/.35)` + `0 0 90px -36px rgb(34 211 238/.22)` |
| `.glow-brand` | `0 0 40px -8px rgb(111 71 245/.35)` |
| `.btn-primary` | `0 4px 20px -6px rgb(111 71 245/.5)` |
| `.btn-deploy` | `0 8px 26px -8px rgb(111 71 245/.55), inset 0 1px 0 0 rgb(255 255 255/.18)`; hover `0 12px 34px -8px …/.7` |
| `.nav-item-active` | `0 4px 16px -6px rgb(111 71 245/.6)` |
| `.lift:hover` | `0 18px 40px -20px rgb(111 71 245/.45)` |
| `.tone-light .card` | `0 1px 2px rgb(15 23 42/.05), 0 16px 36px -20px rgb(15 23 42/.22)` |

The brand violet `rgb(111 71 245)` appears **7 times as a literal** in globals.css rather than
`var(--color-brand-500)` (it is used as a var only in `.btn-deploy`'s `background-image` and
`.nav-underline::after`).

|---|---|

| `--animate-pulse-dot` | `pulse-dot 2s ease-in-out infinite` |

- **@theme group (17):** `bell-shake`, `price-pop`, `panel-in`, `panel-out`, `gh-pop`, `fade-up`, `pulse-dot`,

`3xl` 2, `none` 1, plus **17 distinct arbitrary widths** (`[12rem]`, `[10rem]`, `[24rem]`, `[200px]`,

### 7.3 Grid patterns

`sm:grid-cols-2` 64 · `grid-cols-1` 19 · `grid-cols-2` 18 · `lg:grid-cols-4` 16 · `sm:grid-cols-3` 14 ·
`lg:grid-cols-2` 14 · `lg:grid-cols-3` 12 · `sm:grid-cols-4` 7 · `md:grid-cols-2` 6 · `xl:grid-cols-5` 4 ·
`grid-cols-9` 4 · `grid-cols-7` 3 · `grid-cols-4` 3 · `grid-cols-3` 3 · plus `sm:grid-cols-6`,
`xl:grid-cols-4`, `xl:grid-cols-3`, `sm:grid-cols-5`, `md:grid-cols-8`, `md:grid-cols-4`, and
`grid-cols-[1fr_320px]` ×3.

The card-grid responsive ladder is inconsistent: `sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4` (16),
`sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3` (12), `sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-2` (14), `md:grid-cols-2` (6) —
**four different breakpoint ladders for the same "grid of tiles" idea**, so tile widths jump differently
page to page at the same viewport.

### 7.4 Breakpoints

| Prefix | Usages |
|---|---|
| `sm:` | **181** |
| `lg:` | **118** |
| `md:` | 35 |
| `xl:` | 9 |
| `2xl:` | 1 |

The portal is effectively **sm/lg only** — `md:` (768px) is skipped in 84% of responsive decisions, so
tablet-width layouts inherit either the phone or the desktop treatment depending on which file you're in.
`components/customer/mail/*` is the main `md:` user (three-pane mail), which is why mail behaves
differently from every other page at tablet width.

### 7.5 Z-index census

| Value | Count | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `z-10` | 14 | |
| `z-50` | 13 | modals/palette |
| `z-20` | 11 | Shell header, notification scrim |
| `z-30` | 8 | mobile scrim, dropdown |
| `z-40` | 3 | sidebar |

| `z-[60]` | 4 | **arbitrary** |
| `z-[70]` | 5 | **arbitrary** |
| `z-[100]` | 4 | **arbitrary** |

**15 arbitrary z-index escapes above the scale**, i.e. four ad-hoc stacking tiers (55/60/70/100) invented
to sit above `z-50` modals. Shell's own layering is `sidebar z-40 < scrim z-30 < header z-20`, which
means the header sits *below* the mobile scrim — and CommandPalette at `z-50` sits above the sidebar,
but a `z-[70]` toast-ish overlay sits above the palette. No documented stacking contract.

### 7.6 Padding pattern

Page padding is `px-4 py-8 sm:px-6` (Shell) for normal pages, **zero** for `fullBleed` pages —
so full-bleed routes (mail, terminal, claude-code, calendar) have no shared inner gutter and each
re-establishes its own.

## 8. CHART / VISUALISATION LIBRARIES

| Library | Present |

| recharts | **no** |
| chart.js | **no** |
| d3 (full) | **no** |
| visx / nivo / victory | **no** |
| `d3-geo` + `topojson-client` + `world-atlas` | yes — but for the **admin** visitor map, not the portal (UNVERIFIED that no portal route uses it; no portal import found) |

**All portal charts are hand-written SVG** in `components/ui/charts.tsx` (dependency-free, server-safe):
`Sparkline`, `AreaChart`, `Donut`, `MeterBar`.

Adoption: **8 files** import from `ui/charts.tsx` — `MeterBar` 6, `AreaChart` 2, `Sparkline` 1,
**`Donut` 0 (dead export)**. Users: `customer/DiskUsageChart.tsx` (`AreaChart` + `MeterBar`),
`customer/MetricsPanel.tsx` (3× `AreaChart`), `app/dashboard/servers/[id]/page.tsx`,
`components/customer/HostingClient.tsx`, `app/dashboard/billing/page.tsx`,
`components/customer/cpanel/CronServicesPanel.tsx`, `components/customer/gamepanel/GameOverview.tsx`,
plus `StatCard`'s `Sparkline`.

Everything else that looks like a chart is bespoke: 25 files draw `<polyline>`/`<path d=>`/`<circle cx=>`
directly, and `<canvas>` appears in `claude-code/BuildConsole.tsx` and `claude-code/voice.tsx`.
Chart colours are passed as **hex strings** (`stroke = "#8a70fb"` default in both `Sparkline` and
`StatCard`), not tokens — so a theme change would not reach any chart.

## 9. DIAGNOSIS — top inconsistencies, ranked, with evidence

| # | Finding | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **The design system covers marketing, not the portal.** Of ~30 `@layer components` classes, roughly half (`tone-*`, `eyebrow*`, `hero-aura`, `lift`, `rail`, `nav-trigger`, `nav-underline`, `grad-text`, the auth glow ring, 9 `pv-*`) have **zero portal usage**, while the portal's most repeated patterns (badge, tab, modal, panel-surface, toggle, meter, empty state, code chip) have **no class at all**. | §1.7, §3 |
| 2 | **`primitives.tsx` is 187 lines and mostly formatters.** 79 import sites, but 45 (57%) import `fmtMoney`/`timeAgo`/`fmtBytes`. `PageHeader` reaches 7 files, `StatCard` 2, `ComingSoon` **0**. 166 of 245 portal files import nothing from it. | §3.0 |
| 3 | **7 badge/status-pill implementations** + **26 distinct inline bordered-pill signatures** + **13 borderless** + **20 files with their own status→colour map**. The green "success" pill alone has 7 colour recipes. | §3.2 |
| 4 | **8 tab-bar implementations** (2xl/navy-70, 2xl/navy-80, sticky 2xl, xl/white-3, inline-flex xl/white-3, inline-flex xl/navy-70, border-b-2 underline, rounded-md micro) + 8 more one-off segmented pill rows. 25 files hold tab state; zero shared `<Tabs>`. | §3.4, §3.5 |
| 5 | **24 independent modal/overlay implementations** (`fixed inset-0` ×28 in 24 files), 8 local `*Modal` components, disagreeing backdrops and z-indexes — *while* **60 destructive confirmations use the browser's native `confirm()`** across 30+ files. | §3.6, §3.7 |
| 6 | **21 spellings of "an inset panel"** (`rounded-{lg,xl,2xl} border border-white/{.03–.10} bg-white/{.01–.08}`), ~145 occurrences. Combined with **11 border-white opacities** and **14 bg-white opacities** (including duplicate spellings `/5` vs `/[0.05]`, `/10` vs `/[0.10]`), surface elevation is effectively random. | §2.8, §3.3 |
| 7 | **No icon system.** 0 icon-library imports; **214 inline `<svg>` in 50 files**; ~40 locally-defined `*Icon` components with 10 name collisions across files; **18 distinct strokeWidths**; **15 distinct hardcoded pixel widths** plus three competing Tailwind sizing idioms (`h-4 w-4` / `size-4` / `width="16"`); 70 emoji doing icon duty alongside hand-drawn equivalents of the same glyphs. | §4 |
| 8 | **Type scale is bypassed more than it's used at the small end.** 385 arbitrary `text-[Npx]` (231× `text-[11px]`, 113× `text-[10px]`) vs 1155 `text-xs`; real ramp is 16 sizes of which 7 are scale steps. No tier above `text-2xl` except one `text-4xl` — the portal has **no display type**. `font-semibold` (582) carries almost all emphasis, so hierarchy rests on colour alone. | §5.2, §5.3 |
| 9 | **Page headers are the least consistent surface.** `<h1>` exists in only 10 of 245 files, in **6 different class recipes**; 4 of 64 routes use `<PageHeader>`; most routes have no `<h1>`. `<h2>` has 24 distinct class strings, the top 3 being bare `font-semibold` with different margins. | §3.23, §3.24 |
| 10 | **Violet has no semantic job**, which is why it dominates: it is simultaneously primary CTA (`.btn-primary` ×163), active nav (`.nav-item-active`), info surface (`bg-brand-500/N` ×121 in **12 opacities**), highlight text (`text-brand-300` 180 + `text-brand-200` 96), the signature gradient (44 inline `from-accent-blue…to-brand-500` in 7 opacity variants), and the page background wash. `brand-*` = 787 utility usages vs `accent-cyan` 15. | §2.4 |
| 11 | **Motion is unguarded.** 69 animation applications, only **8** `motion-safe:`-prefixed; 3 portal files handle `prefers-reduced-motion`. `animate-fade-up` fires on `<main>` **and** on inner panels, double-animating tab switches. 225 of 240 transitions never set a duration; `.card-hover` (200ms) and `.btn-*` (150ms) disagree. 10 of 17 `--animate-*` tokens are portal-dead; all 9 `pv-*` classes are dead. | §6 |
| 12 | **~50 of 185 hex literals restate an existing token**, and 3 are *near-misses* of it (`#0a0e1a`, `#05060f`, `#05060d` vs `navy-900 #0a101f` / `navy-950 #060a14`) — visually a slightly-wrong surface. A duplicate of `.nav-item-active`'s shadow is pasted inline 4× as `shadow-[0_4px_16px_-6px_rgb(111_71_245_/_0.6)]`. Chart strokes are hardcoded `#8a70fb`, so charts can never be re-themed. | §2.3, §2.2, §8 |
| 13 | **6 toggle-switch implementations** in 2 sizes and 2 DOM strategies (JS state vs `peer-checked`), across 14 files; no `role="switch"` convention. Checkboxes use 4 different accent colours (`accent-brand-500` 18, `accent-brand-400` 5, `accent-sky-500` 1, none 16). | §3.22 |
| 14 | **Two parallel control panels** (`components/customer/cpanel/*` for VPS, `components/customer/hosting/*` for shared hosting) reimplement Websites, Databases, Cron, Apps and FileManager, each with its own `shared.tsx` that redefines `EmptyState`, a status pill, a skeleton and a copy button already present in `primitives.tsx`/globals.css. | §3.20 |
| 15 | **13 copy-to-clipboard implementations**, **~15 `<code>` skins** (6 different backgrounds for the same idea), **10 places rendering DNS record rows**, **6 terminal/console surfaces** (2 xterm + 4 hand-rolled), **2 file browsers**, **5 local `Row` + 4 local `Field`** components, **8 wizards each drawing their own step indicator**, **12 hand-rolled progress bars** in 4 track recipes. | §3.13–§3.21 |
| 16 | **Layout has no contract.** Three page geometries selected by Shell props; 46 of 58 routes declare no width; 17 arbitrary `max-w-[…]`; portal rail (`max-w-7xl`/`max-w-[100rem]`) ≠ marketing rail (`.rail max-w-6xl`, unused here); `md:` skipped in 84% of responsive decisions; **15 arbitrary z-index escapes** (55/60/70/100) above a `z-50` modal tier with no documented stacking order; `.card`'s own `p-6` overridden in 63 of 314 uses. | §7, §2.9 |
| 17 | **`text-[var(--fg)]` (23 uses, all in `components/customer/freemc/*`) imports the marketing light/dark tone token into the always-dark portal**, where no `.tone-light` ancestor exists — a cross-system borrow that is a no-op today and a latent bug if tones ever land in the portal. | §3.24, §1.3 |
| 18 | **Tables:** 41 `<table>` vs 34 `.table-shell`; 8 distinct `min-w-[…]` scroll widths; the scroll wrapper class `table-wrap` is referenced but **has no definition in globals.css** (UNVERIFIED whether defined elsewhere — no definition found). | §3.9 |
| 19 | **`tabular-nums` used only 17×** despite 30 large numeric readouts and many live counters — metric tiles and tables jitter as digits change. | §5.6 |
| 20 | **No toast/notification system at all.** 19+ files hold local `setMsg`/`setNotice`/`setError` state rendered as an inline coloured strip, in at least 2 spellings *within the same file* (`hosting/DbManager.tsx` uses both `rounded-xl … px-4 py-3 text-xs` and `rounded-lg … px-2 py-1.5 text-[11px]` for the same error idea). `alert()` is still used for some errors. | §3.8 |

### Highest-leverage consolidation targets (inventory view, no design proposal)

Ordered by (occurrences saved × files touched):

1. **Surface/panel class** — collapses 21 signatures / ~145 sites.
2. **Badge + status-tone table** — collapses 7 impls / ~40 inline pills / 20 status maps.
3. **Button size variants** — removes ~48 bespoke buttons and every `btn-* px-N py-N text-[Npx]` override.
4. **Tabs component** — collapses 8 tab-bars + 8 segmented rows across 25 stateful files.
5. **Modal + ConfirmDialog** — collapses 24 overlays and retires 60 native `confirm()` calls.
6. **Icon module** (adopt a library, or promote `marketing/icons.tsx` + `OverviewIcons.tsx` into one set) — retires ~40 local `*Icon` components and normalises 214 inline SVGs, 18 strokeWidths, 15 pixel sizes.
7. **Type scale extension** (add 10px/11px/13px steps as tokens) — removes 385 arbitrary `text-[Npx]`.
8. **Toast system** — replaces ~19 files' bespoke inline status strips.
9. **PageHeader adoption** — 60 of 64 routes currently bypass it.
10. **Meter/Progress + Skeleton/Spinner primitives** — collapses 12 bars (4 track recipes) and 4 loading idioms.
